parts.text:
<document id=DOC_release_note>
Release 4.2 closes three reported defects. The importer no longer
drops a trailing column when a file ends without a newline. The
scheduler retries a failed job twice before reporting it. The audit
log records the account that performed a deletion.
</document>

Summarise the release note above as a bulleted list.

Use at most three bullets. Keep every sentence to at most twelve words.
Begin each bullet with a capital letter and write it as a complete
sentence with a subject and a verb.

response.text:
* The importer keeps trailing columns in files without a final newline.
* The scheduler retries failed jobs twice before reporting them.
* The audit log records the account that performs a deletion.
